style: 3D cartoon, original design, tax satire, slapstick
subject: ONE plump male hedgehog on hind legs, brown quills, round belly
second_characters: TWO silent magpies in green accountant visors; the second wears a leather pouch
props: dozens of plain white envelopes spiked on his quills, blank, no digits
environment: autumn forest edge by day: a burrow under an oak root, dry leaves, a low branch above
motion_rule: camera always moving, orbiting the hedgehog in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves, each ending on the gag. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where a muzzle or beak fills the whole frame. Cuts only at 5.85, 7.80.

audio.pacing: no pauses between sentences; first word at 0.30; last word by 5.85; no words after 6.1
audio.pronunciation: KAZH-dyy GOD a-be-SHCHA-yu, shto raz-be-RUS s na-LO-ga-mi. a pa-TOM a-NI raz-bi-RA-yut-sya sa MNOY.
audio.sfx: leaf rustle, wing claps, hedgehog huffs

timeline.a: large in frame: the hedgehog, a curled ball bristling with envelopes, tumbles from the burrow, some fly past the lens; the first magpie lands on the branch, the second shakes its pouch
timeline.c: low, swooping hard at him through the leaves

timeline.a: close-up: jaw working, at once the hedgehog lunges body-first into the lens, his muzzle filling the frame, right paw up in an oath; then pricks his paw on a quill, hops
jaw working, the hedgehog yanks an envelope off his shoulder, spinning to eye it
jaw working, the hedgehog slaps it back on his crown, quills bristling; the magpies crouch on the branch
jaw working, at a wing clap the hedgehog scuttles backward to the burrow, head up; the magpies dive
jaw working, the magpies hover over the hedgehog, talons spread, not touching; the hedgehog jabs his chest and hops
both magpies land on the hedgehog's back, each yanks a quill; the hedgehog hops with them aboard
the hedgehog curls into a ball, the magpies pluck it, tufts of quills with envelopes fly past the lens
close-up: the first magpie lunges beak-first into the lens, quill and envelope in beak, filling the frame; behind, the hedgehog ball bounces
the camera hurls itself from far: the hedgehog unrolls bare, pink, goosebumped, unhurt, reaching for his back; the second magpie plucks the last quill
close-up: jolted by the tug, the hedgehog lunges into the lens, his bare muzzle filling the frame, blinking; behind, the second magpie stuffs the quill in its pouch, snapping it shut
the hedgehog snatches a fallen envelope, covering himself like a fig leaf; the magpies take off, a leaf drifting past the lens
by habit the hedgehog curls up: a bare pink ball, envelope in front, puffing; the magpies fly off behind the oak
